collections.name: The Soft Power Edit
collections.lookAlt: Lookbook plate: midnight navy ribbed knit midi dress layered over a powder-blue striped shirt, with patent bow pumps, a black top-handle bag and gold jewellery.

collections.name: The Boardroom Edit
collections.lookAlt: Lookbook plate: Prince-of-Wales check tailored blazer and mini skirt with a white cotton shirt, chocolate silk necktie, gold-cap pumps and espresso leather handbag.

collections.name: Lavender Hour
collections.lookAlt: Lookbook plate: oversized brushed lavender fleece sweatshirt with a butter-yellow leather mini skirt, matching pumps and shoulder bag, gradient sunglasses and gold jewellery.

products.name: Red-stitch indigo denim midi
products.desc: Dark indigo denim cut straight to the calf, the front split edged in red topstitch that carries up every seam and around the waistband. Denim with a formal streak, from desk to dinner.

products.name: Two-tone denim pencil skirt
products.desc: A light-wash denim yoke, buttoned in brass across the hip, gives way to a deep navy pencil that opens in a side split. Two washes, one clean vertical line.

products.name: Asymmetric-hem denim midi
products.desc: Dark denim wraps the waist and sweeps across the front in a diagonal seam, releasing into an uneven hem with a pale grey jersey reverse. The layered cut keeps the weight moving.

products.name: Button-front denim A-line maxi
products.desc: A high-waisted A-line in mid-blue denim, closed by brass shank buttons from waistband to ankle. Controlled through the hip, breaking wide at the hem.

products.name: Denim peplum midi skirt
products.desc: Light-wash denim closes in a full button placket that runs to the knee, where the skirt gathers into a peplum flare and opens in a front split. Fitted above, generous below.

products.name: Crystal-bow denim midi
products.desc: Three crystal bows sit at the side of a light-wash denim midi, spaced down a button placket that ends in a walking split. The shine is kept to one line.

products.name: Side-placket denim midi
products.desc: Mid-wash denim falls straight from the waist, closed by a button placket down the side seam that opens into a low split. Softened denim, sharp line.

products.name: Chocolate leather wrap maxi
products.desc: Chocolate leather wraps across the hip in a folded layer, releasing into a floor-length skirt with a soft, weighted drape. One diagonal seam does all the work.

products.name: Blush draped asymmetric skirt
products.desc: Pale pink satin is draped from a high waist with a utility pocket at the hip and a length of navy webbing cinching one side. Soft volume, hardware awake.

products.name: Scarlet asymmetric skirt
products.desc: Scarlet crepe wraps on the diagonal and cuts away at the side to show a grey-striped reverse, finishing in an asymmetric hem. Dress it high and let the layers speak.

products.name: Fern green leather pencil skirt
products.desc: Fern green leather cut to a high-waisted pencil with covered buttons at the side and a long front slit. Lined so it slides over the body and falls clean at the ankle.

products.name: Colour-block knit midi
products.desc: Red, sky and blush diamonds are knit into a midi that ends in a deep pleated navy hem. The stretch follows the body and the pleats give the walk its swing.

products.name: Geometric print A-line midi
products.desc: Forest, cream, marigold and blush polygons are arranged on a structured A-line that ends in a diagonal hem. The print is bold, but the cut keeps it close.

products.name: Sunlit graphic silk skirt
products.desc: A scarf-print silk in gold, caramel and graphite wraps at the hip and falls into a draped, handkerchief hem. It moves with air and settles into a new line each time.

products.name: Rose gathered A-line maxi
products.desc: A deep rose satin gathered evenly at the waist and released into a full floor-length sweep. The volume runs all round, so it reads formal from any angle.

products.name: Ivory pleated print skirt
products.desc: Ivory pleats fall from a wrapped waistband, with painterly print panels surfacing near an uneven hem. Soft and romantic, cut to move rather than stand.

products.name: Marigold feather-embellished skirt
products.desc: Silk feathers are stitched down the front of a marigold crepe column, each with a long thread that catches the air as you walk. The rest of the skirt stays plain.
products.fabric: Silk crepe with silk feather appliqué

products.name: Emerald draped maxi skirt
products.desc: Emerald taffeta is gathered through the waist, folded at the hip and dropped into a high-low hem. Long, serious folds that break into a flash of leg at the front.

products.name: Pinstripe peplum skirt
products.desc: An ivory column is interrupted by a white-pinstriped peplum that circles the hip and tumbles into pleats. Tailoring with a sense of humour, and its line intact.

products.name: Lilac ribbed mermaid maxi
products.desc: Fine lilac ribbing follows the body from waist to knee, then breaks into coiled, sculptural ruffles at the floor. It holds its shape and still moves.

products.name: Indigo denim midi skirt
products.desc: Deep indigo denim sits high on the waist and falls straight to the midi hem, with a front seam that opens into a slit. It softens with wear and keeps its line.

products.name: Butter leather mini skirt
products.desc: Butter-yellow leather in a clean, high-waisted mini with a short side split. Soft enough to sit close, bright enough to carry a whole outfit.

products.name: Lace-trim black balloon pant
products.desc: A fluid black balloon leg that tapers at the ankle, finished with scalloped lace at the waist and a slim ribbon tie. Tailoring above, ease below.

products.name: Swan-clasp black balloon trouser
products.desc: Black barrel-leg trousers with a pressed crease and a curved leather belt set at one hip, clasped with a small gold swan. The contrast is all in the hardware.

products.name: Chocolate seamed balloon trouser
products.desc: Chocolate trousers cut high and closed with a single pale button, curved seams shaping a balloon leg that finishes in turn-up cuffs. Soft volume, sharp finish.

products.name: Olive button-front balloon trouser
products.desc: Olive balloon trousers open on a diagonal placket of brass shank buttons that runs from the high waist to the narrow cuff. The buttons do the styling for you.

products.name: Wine corduroy balloon trouser
products.desc: Deep wine fine-wale corduroy is wrapped at the hip by a glossy leather panel that folds across the front and tapers into the balloon leg. Texture in place of a belt.

products.name: Ivory corduroy balloon pant
products.desc: Ivory corduroy cut wide and round through the leg, with angled panel seams and a slim brown leather belt at the waist. A soft trouser with a strict top line.

products.name: Ivory draped balloon pant
products.desc: An asymmetric waistband folds over and buttons at one hip, releasing into a heavy crepe drape that rounds out at the hem. One button, one fold, plenty of volume.

products.name: Coffee check balloon trouser
products.desc: A coffee-and-cream check through a high-waisted balloon leg: sharp at the waist, round through the thigh, cropped at the ankle. Suiting that moves like a trouser.

products.name: Olive coated balloon trouser
products.desc: Coated olive with a quiet sheen, pressed front creases and a clean high waist. The balloon leg keeps its shape from hip to cuff without stiffening.
products.care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth

products.name: Taupe quilted balloon pant
products.desc: Taupe twill with scalloped front pocket flaps and diamond quilting across the knee, falling into a rounded, ankle-skimming leg. Utility detailing, softened by the cut.

products.name: Chocolate pleated balloon pant
products.desc: Deep pleats fall from a double-button waist tab into a full chocolate leg, gathered back in at the cuff. The volume starts at the waist and stays controlled.

products.name: Black leather-yoke balloon trouser
products.desc: A wide asymmetric leather yoke wraps the high waist before the leg releases into soft black volume. One clean line from hip to ankle.
products.fabric: Woven shell with leather waist yoke

products.name: Sculpted drape-shoulder top
products.desc: Matte black crepe with princess seams through the body and heavy drape folded across the shoulders. The waist is sharp; the shoulders do the softening.

products.name: Rust bow-shoulder top
products.desc: Rust satin-backed crepe wraps across the chest and ties in a bow at one shoulder, then narrows through the waist into a curved, asymmetric hem. Formal fabric, off-centre line.

products.name: Ivory peplum sash top
products.desc: Ivory crepe with a folded shoulder line, a cinched peplum waist and long sash tails falling past the hip. The volume is all in the tails; the body stays close.

products.name: Black mesh ruffle top
products.desc: Fine black mesh gathered into one asymmetric ruffle that wraps a shoulder and falls down the side. Sheer where it counts, structured where it does not.

products.name: Crimson raw-edge jacket top
products.desc: A crimson textured bustier jacket with fringed raw edges at every seam, cut away at the waist over a black underlayer. Built to look unfinished, made to hold its shape.

products.name: Cream raw-edge puff-sleeve top
products.desc: Cream textured cloth left raw and frayed at the seams, with rounded puff sleeves, a folded neckline and an asymmetric zip. Soft colour, deliberately rough edges.

products.name: Cropped denim jacket top
products.desc: A cropped indigo denim jacket with an oversized fold collar, gold shank buttons and a self-tie waist. Contrast cuffs finish the sleeve; the crop keeps it sharp.

products.name: Merlot leather-sleeve corset top
products.desc: A merlot felted corset with sculpted waist seams, framed by puffed leather sleeves and a row of gold shank buttons. Structured body, soft volume at the arm.

products.name: Camel hooded corset jacket
products.desc: Camel suede panels a corset-cut jacket, with a hood at the neck, an exposed zip through the waist and ribbed cuffs. Sportswear shapes, kept dressy.

products.name: Burgundy satin corset top
products.desc: Deep burgundy satin with a V neckline, satin lapels and three frog closures down a boned waist. Wide folded cuffs balance the close fit.

products.name: Grey plaid knot-front blouse
products.desc: A grey check blouse gathered through a twisted knot at the shoulder, with blouson sleeves and a cinched waist. The wrap makes the volume feel deliberate.

products.name: Sheer organza ruffle top
products.desc: Translucent ivory organza layered into soft, sculptural ruffles that stand away from the shoulder and hem. Light enough to move, firm enough to hold.

products.name: Burgundy draped halter top
products.desc: Deep burgundy crepe drapes from a wrapped halter neckline, cinched by a glossy leather waistband and a short leather peplum. Soft above, hard at the waist.

products.name: Black studded leather top
products.desc: Black leather cut into a high-collar jacket top with flap pockets, gold studs at the closures and a peplum flaring over the hip. Heavy material, precise shape.

products.name: Chocolate satin jewel-button shirt
products.desc: Chocolate satin with a draped wrap front, three jewel-set buttons at the placket and long bishop sleeves. The shine is deep rather than bright.

products.name: Pinstripe wrap shirt
products.desc: A chocolate pinstripe shirt wrapped at the waist and fastened with a leather tab and tie, falling into an asymmetric hem. Shirt tailoring, dressy intention.

products.name: Stone asymmetric blouse
products.desc: Stone linen with an off-shoulder collar, gathered at one hip by a single jewel button and released into an asymmetric hem. The drape is loose; the button holds it.

products.name: White sculpted-neckline top
products.desc: A clean white top with a sculpted roll neckline that curves over the shoulder, cap sleeves and a fitted waist. Sharp, simple, and all about the neckline.

products.name: Olive suede wrap blouse
products.desc: Olive faux suede with a soft collar, a wrap front tied at the waist and an asymmetric hem. The suede keeps the drape from going limp.

products.name: Olive suede belted peplum top
products.desc: An olive suede top with a cowl neckline, wide sleeves and a square-buckle belt setting off a pleated peplum. Waist defined, volume below.

products.name: Chocolate overlay bodysuit
products.desc: A chocolate faux-leather overlay curves across one shoulder over a matching knit bodysuit, with gathered puff sleeves and ribbed cuffs. One palette, two finishes.

products.name: Cream overlay bodysuit
products.desc: An ivory faux-leather overlay cuts a curved line across a taupe knit bodysuit, with puff sleeves and a high-cut leg. Clean edges, soft body.

products.name: Taupe long-sleeve overlay bodysuit
products.desc: A taupe leather-look overlay sits over a chocolate knit body, pointed at the waist and finished with long sleeves and ribbed cuffs. The contrast is all in tone.

products.name: Beige scoop overlay bodysuit
products.desc: A soft beige overlay sweeps across a scoop-neck nude bodysuit, with unstructured shoulders and a high-cut leg. Almost skin-toned, entirely deliberate.

products.name: Camel hooded zip bodysuit
products.desc: A cropped camel hoodie with a zip front and dropped shoulders, layered over a matching knit bodysuit. Soft sportswear, cut for a skirt.

products.name: Grey cape-sleeve blazer
products.desc: A fitted single-breasted blazer with wide notched lapels and cape sleeves that fall in soft tiers to the wrist. Three covered buttons keep the front quiet.

products.name: Camel cape-sleeve blazer
products.desc: The same sculpted blazer in warm camel: wide lapels, tiered cape sleeves and covered buttons on a fitted, cropped body. Sharp shoulders, soft movement.

products.name: Cream asymmetric cape blazer
products.desc: A cream textured blazer with a stand collar and an asymmetric cape panel across one shoulder, cinched by a gold clasp and finished with flap pockets. Tailoring, edited.

products.name: Navy horse-bit knit polo
products.desc: A fitted navy knit polo with a burgundy spread collar and placket edge, closed at the throat by a gold horse-bit clasp. Cap sleeves and a ribbed band hem keep it sharp.

products.name: Cream horse-bit knit polo
products.desc: The horse-bit polo in cream, a burgundy collar and placket trim framing the neck. The gold clasp sits at the throat and the body fits close to a ribbed hem.

products.name: Chocolate horse-bit knit polo
products.desc: Deep chocolate knit with a burgundy contrast collar and horse-bit clasp, cut close with cap sleeves and a ribbed waistband. Sits clean over tailoring.

products.name: Pleated-rib polo crop
products.desc: A cream cropped polo in a fine pleated rib, from a crisp white pointed collar through short pleated sleeves to a smooth ribbed waistband.

products.name: Olive zip-front knit jacket
products.desc: An olive ribbed knit jacket with a boxy cropped body, zipped to a brown faux-leather pointed collar, finished with ribbed cuffs and hem.

products.name: Olive bit-placket crew
products.desc: A soft olive crew-neck knit with ribbed edges, the plain front broken by three silver horse-bit clasps down a short placket.

products.name: Cream scallop-trim polo
products.desc: A cream short-sleeve polo with an open collar edged in black scalloped crochet, short ribbed sleeves and a fitted body over a ribbed hem.

products.name: Red zigzag-trim polo
products.desc: A fitted red knit polo traced with white embroidered zigzag along the collar and placket, with short ribbed sleeves and a ribbed band hem.

products.name: Ivory bird-embroidery knit
products.desc: An ivory sleeveless knit with a ribbed crew neck and armholes, worked across the front with embroidered birds and blossoms in muted green, rose and blue.

products.name: Beige cable knit with denim collar
products.desc: A beige cable knit with blouson sleeves and ribbed edges, topped by an attached soft denim pointed collar that opens into a deep V.

products.name: Black knit with denim collar
products.desc: A fine black knit finished with a denim pointed collar, denim placket and rolled denim cuffs, set with a crystal brooch at the chest.
products.fabric: Fine-gauge knit, denim collar and cuffs

products.name: Forest cable knit with flared hem
products.desc: Forest-green cable panels run down a fitted sleeveless body, closing at the waist where the ribbed hem kicks out into a soft peplum flare.

products.name: Houndstooth ruched-sleeve jacket
products.desc: A cropped camel-and-chocolate houndstooth jacket with a high funnel collar, snap placket, flap chest pockets, ruched sleeves and a drawcord waist pulled tight.

products.name: Chocolate snap-front cropped jacket
products.desc: A chocolate cropped jacket with a spread collar, gold snaps on a curved placket and flap pockets, blouson sleeves gathered into tight cuffs.

products.name: Tartan cropped jacket
products.desc: A cropped collarless jacket in blue and charcoal tartan, buttoned in antique gold with puffed sleeves and ribbed cuffs.

products.name: Rose faux-suede zip jacket
products.desc: A rose faux-suede jacket with a funnel collar and silver zip front, seamed through the sleeves and finished with snap-tab cuffs.

products.name: Black satin lace-waist gown
products.desc: Black satin with a high mandarin collar and cap sleeves, the midriff cut away into sheer lace. The skirt wraps, knots at one hip and falls to a floor-length slit.

products.name: Ivory fringed off-shoulder gown
products.desc: An ivory off-shoulder gown, draped smooth over the bodice and hip, the skirt built in tiers of beaded champagne, sand and charcoal fringe to a pointed hem.

products.name: Emerald draped fringe gown
products.desc: Emerald satin draped on the bias and wrapped at the waist of a one-shoulder gown, releasing into tiered fringe to the floor. The shine lives in the movement.

products.name: Navy star-jacquard fringe gown
products.desc: Midnight star jacquard fits the body with cap sleeves and a V neck, the hip seam scalloped before four tiers of fringe fall to the floor.

products.name: Pale blue organza petal gown
products.desc: Pale blue organza petals, each edged in black, cascade from one shoulder over a sheer black tulle base. Layers that read light, edges that keep it sharp.

products.name: Lime bow corset gown
products.desc: A strapless black corset with lattice boning and lace-trimmed cups, wrapped at the waist by an oversized lime satin bow above a full pleated skirt.

products.name: Champagne draped-bodice gown
products.desc: A black bodice is wrapped in deep champagne satin, cowled and knotted at the waist, then released into a draped skirt with a sweeping train.

products.name: Ivory jacquard column with corsage
products.desc: A floor-length ivory column in tonal fern jacquard, its off-shoulder stand collar sculpted over one shoulder, finished with a lilac floral corsage.

products.name: Black velvet petal gown
products.desc: Black velvet scalloped into petals outlined in fine gold piping, strapless, with a cluster of crystal flowers set at the bust.

products.name: Red velvet petal gown
products.desc: Deep red velvet petals fall from an off-shoulder band over a sheer organza yoke, building down the column to a ruched hem.

products.name: Black sculpted trumpet gown
products.desc: A strapless black column pleated down the body, flaring at the hip into two sculpted folds that break into trailing ribbon streamers.

products.name: Gold satin drop-waist gown
products.desc: Gold satin with a halter neck and high collar, corset seams through the fitted bodice, and a dropped waist releasing into a gathered bubble skirt.

products.name: Teal off-shoulder gown with train
products.desc: Teal satin with a folded off-shoulder neckline edged in silver beading, draped from one shoulder into a floor-sweeping train.

products.name: Ice-blue beaded fringe gown
products.desc: Spaghetti straps and a sweetheart neckline above a fitted body beaded from ice blue into royal blue, cascading into a skirt of shimmering fringe.

products.name: Midnight beaded fringe gown
products.desc: Thin straps and a straight neck over a body beaded in sparkling arcs, the pattern opening into long strands of fringe that fall past the hem.

products.name: Rose dégradé fringe gown
products.desc: A strapless bustier layered in fringed tiers that fade from champagne and rose at the chest to chocolate at the floor.

products.name: Ivory beaded strapless gown
products.desc: A pleated strapless bodice above a skirt layered in pearl and crystal beadwork scalloped through netting, finishing in a beaded fringe hem.

products.name: Sage leaf-petal gown
products.desc: A sleeveless gown with a plunging V neck, its skirt built from layered sage leaf petals with a silver shimmer that spill into a sweeping hem.

products.name: White halter gown with lace cut-outs
products.desc: A white halter column with a keyhole neck and cut-out sides framed in black lace, falling clean to the floor.

products.name: Silver beaded deep-V gown
products.desc: Silver satin with a deep V neckline and long bell sleeves, ruched around a beaded centre panel and finished with a flounced mermaid hem.

products.name: Cobalt draped halter gown
products.desc: A single length of cobalt jersey tied at the nape and left to fall in fine horizontal pleats over the body, skimming the bust and hips before pooling at the floor. The halter neck keeps the shoulders bare.

products.name: Ivory pencil skirt with black lace
products.desc: Ivory crepe cut close from waist to mid-calf and framed with scalloped black Chantilly lace at both the waistband and the hem. A short back vent keeps the step easy.

products.name: Polka-dot lace-hem mini skirt
products.desc: Powder blue scattered with burgundy dots that shift in scale across the skirt, ending in a deep band of scalloped lace dyed to match. Straight through the hip and short by design.
products.fabric: Printed woven shell, scalloped lace hem

products.name: Apricot wrap pleated mini skirt
products.desc: An apricot mini wrapped once across the front and left to dip over a sharply pleated underlayer in a deeper terracotta. The clean waistband keeps it dressy; the pleats give it swing.

products.name: Burgundy leather-yoke mini skirt
products.desc: A high burgundy waist in crinkled leather, closed down one side with three gold crest buttons and giving way to a gathered satin skirt that flares softly from the hip.
products.care: Wipe clean with a soft cloth

products.name: Black tulle lattice midi skirt
products.desc: Fine black tulle caught under a lattice of ribbon, layered over a short opaque underskirt and left sheer below the knee. Full through the sweep, weightless on.

products.name: Green floral draped midi skirt
products.desc: A sage floral print gathered diagonally from the hip and falling straight to a mid-calf hem, with a black lace yoke at the waist that shows a flash of skin.
products.fabric: Printed mesh over satin lining, lace waist

title: Power,
softened.
ads.copy: Powder-blue poplin beneath midnight ribbed knit. Authority, with a pulse.

title: Tailored,
never tamed.
ads.copy: Prince-of-Wales check, a chocolate silk tie, a gold-capped heel that means business.

title: A little joy,
elegantly worn.
ads.copy: Brushed lavender fleece, butter-soft leather, and gold that catches the evening light.
